reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior loan of up to US$ 80 million in MNT or US dollar equivalent to XacBank JSC ("XacBank") under the EBRD Youth in Business Programme in Central Asia ("YiB CA Programme"), aimed at supporting youth-led or youth-owned micro, small, and medium sized enterprises in Mongolia ("Youth MSMEs"). The project will address the shortage of credit available to Youth MSMEs and help remove structural barriers to their growth in Mongolia. It will focus on strengthening and embedding the banking infrastructure needed for sustainable youth-focused lending, enhancing XacBank's capacity to provide tailored financial products and support services, and ultimately promoting the long-term inclusion of young entrepreneurs in Mongolia's MSME market.
